name: cluster-serp
description:
Cluster the phrases of a SERP table (columns phrase, position, url) by the common URLs of their tops.

method: "soft" grows a cluster around its center: a phrase joins when it shares enough URLs with the center; "hard" lets a phrase join only when it shares enough URLs with every member of the cluster.
common: how many URLs two phrases must share.
top: how many first positions of each phrase count.

One row per phrase: phrase, cluster (1 = the largest), center (the first phrase of the cluster) and common (URLs shared with the center; the center gets the size of its own top).

Example: semkit read serp.csv cluster-serp write -
-> диван купить, 1, диван купить, 3; купить диван, 1, диван купить, 3; кресло, 2, кресло, 3

freq: a file with the phrases in its first text column and their frequencies in --freq-column; the file is read like `read` does.
freq_column: the column of the frequencies in the --freq file; by default the first column of numbers.

The step reads the current table, a SERP with the columns phrase, position and url; the table of the clusters replaces it, its column phrase is the working one.
